summary: M6_2S_BOUNDARY_ADVERSARY (mode=analysis_only). In-scope fail gates M6-FAIL-007 (no-evidence / overstated readiness / self-cert / false progress) and M6-FAIL-008 (raw secret / PII on a durable/export surface); rules RULE-001 (Core owns the event registry — M6 never writes/invents/reconciles/decides the permit-mapping), RULE-014 (no raw PII), RULE-015 (no self-cert). ENTRY GATE verified in the ledger: M6-P2705=RUNNING (row 265), dependency M6-P2704=PASS (TESTER_RUN: full staged suite 716 passed/0 failed RC0; SMK-031 28/28), M6-P2701/2702/2703=PASS, entry judge M6-P2700=SIGNED (chains to M6-P2609 M6.2R judge SIGNED). METHOD: a byte-clean EXECUTED harness (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 py -3.12 -B, Python 3.12.10; no PII/phone/email literal — the free-text-echo marker is a neutral 22-char alpha string, no literal secret/PII in source; stdout reconfigured to UTF-8 for VN text) drives the real staged reader + feed models + validator coercers + masking; every claimed breach is executed and its actual outcome asserted before classification; plus a 5-finder + completeness-critic workflow (wf_c5a95d1e-b15, 44+5 vectors, high effort) whose novel vectors were re-executed here (GROUP N) before classification. RESULT: 34 recorded outcomes = 28 DEFENDED, 5 OPEN_NONGATE (armed-not-fired), 1 NOTE, 0 BREACH. IN-SCOPE FAIL-007/FAIL-008/RULE-001/014/015 BREACHES: 0. FEED FAIL-CLOSED (VERIFIED): a non-Mapping feed -> feed_error:not_mapping; a bad registry_version (missing / '1' str / 1.0 float / True / False bool — bool explicitly excluded from int) -> feed_error:bad_version; a non-list/tuple events -> feed_error:bad_events; a non-Mapping row -> feed_error:row_not_mapping; a missing/blank/whitespace/non-str event_code -> feed_error:missing_event_code; a valid-then-garbage feed applies NOTHING (all-or-nothing parse-all-first, version 0, rows not stored); a fully-valid feed (events as a tuple) DOES apply + bump the version (non-vacuous). STALENESS (VERIFIED): no-downgrade (an equal or older version -> 'stale', the stored row not overwritten); no staleness poison (a malformed higher-version feed does not bump the version, so a later genuine feed at that version still applies); delta upsert (a since_version feed does not drop omitted rows, updates apply, prior rows survive); de-registration arrives is_active=False; a within-feed duplicate event_code is last-wins single-order no-crash; version edges (0/-5 -> stale; huge applies once). RESOLVE FAIL-CLOSED (VERIFIED): every unknown/None/blank/non-str external_send_policy -> BLOCKED_DEFAULT (never a fabricated ALLOW_EXTERNAL; near-miss casing does not become the member); unknown/None/M3 'SENSITIVE'/'' data_sensitivity -> PII (most restrictive), real PUBLIC/INTERNAL map through; is_active strict identity 'is True' (1/'true'/0/[]/1.0 -> False, only real True -> True); valid tokens map through; a Core-classified ALLOW_EXTERNAL row is faithfully READ (M6 does not override the Core registry, RULE-001) yet reading opens NO egress (no send verb, EXTERNAL_SEND Final OFF, is_external_send_enabled() False); no invented vocabulary (unknown -> an existing member). CORE-OWNED / NO SELF-CERT (VERIFIED): the reader exposes no insert/create/write/register/reconcile verb (only apply() upserts feed-supplied rows); no enum reconciliation minted (SENSITIVE->PII fail-closed, enum stays {PUBLIC,INTERNAL,PII}); result reasons are only applied/stale/feed_error:* (no Pass/Ready/Authorized token, RULE-015); the PROPOSED name/shape carries a TODO(contract) marker (final = chief-issued). PII/EXPORT (VERIFIED): to_public exports exactly the 7 governance fields (no PII/secret/auth field NAME); no endpoint-auth/secret field is stored or exported; the reader + feed-model modules bind NO HTTP/transport surface (requests/httpx/urllib/http/socket/aiohttp) — the live M3 client is not built, so there is no endpoint URL/auth on any durable/export surface. RESIDUALS (5 OPEN_NONGATE, all armed-not-fired — in-process code-exec / trusted-in-shape Core source / no durable sink; NONE trips an in-scope gate; routed): P2 (F-FEED-PII) to_public echoes the free-text metadata (event_code/event_group/domain/updated_at) VERBATIM with no masking choke (a 22-char marker survives raw in all fields and mask() would have altered any >5-char value), so a contract-violating M3 feed that smuggled a PII-shaped value into a metadata field would export it raw — armed-not-fired because the feed is a TRUSTED Core-owned governance source (PII_FIELDS['EventRegistryRow']=() by contract) AND to_public reaches no durable sink (see N1); route SECURITY M6-P2706/owner (reject or mask a PII-shaped metadata value). N2 (CRIT-02, novel) the MUTATION phase is not exception-atomic — a 2nd-row event_code whose __hash__ raises commits the 1st row, leaves the version unbumped, and propagates the exception out of apply() (half-apply + crash), so 'never crash / never half-apply' holds for bad-row REJECTION (parse phase) but not the upsert phase; in-process only (JSON yields a plain str whose hash never raises); route CODER (atomic swap of local copies). N3 (CRIT-03/S-04) an int SUBCLASS with hostile __le__ defeats the '<=' staleness guard (equal/lower version applies -> replay/downgrade) — the guard excludes bool but does not canonicalize; in-process only (a JSON feed gives a plain int); route CODER (int(version) / type(version) is int). N4 (CRIT-04, novel) event_code is stored UNTRIMMED (_nonblank_str tests strip() truthiness but returns the original), so 'purchase ' and 'purchase' are distinct keys and a de-registration delta misses the padded stale-active row (both retained) — channel-reachable in value but no egress/sink so no gate trip; route CHIEF/CODER (canonicalize/reject non-canonical event_code, do not self-resolve). N5 (resolve BND-01, carried M6.2P) a hostile-__eq__/__hash__ object coerces to ALLOW_EXTERNAL/PUBLIC via the enum value2member lookup — _resolve_send_policy/_resolve_sensitivity have no isinstance(str) gate before ExternalSendPolicy(raw)/DataSensitivity(raw); in-process code-exec ONLY (a JSON feed yields str/None/int, all fail-closed; a str-subclass equal to ALLOW_EXTERNAL genuinely IS that value) and reading opens no egress; route CODER (isinstance str gate, carried M6.2P). LOAD-BEARING CONTAINMENT (N1, DEFENDED): the P2 free-text-echo residual is armed-not-fired ONLY because to_public reaches NO durable sink — PII_FIELDS has no 'RegistryFeedRow' key AND no non-test app/ module imports the reader or feed models (grep-clean across app/); this is the standing watch-item — P2 flips to a live FAIL-008 breach the moment any app module serializes to_public OR the live M3 seam (ENTRY-003) is wired (a value-level PII scrub + a PII_FIELDS['RegistryFeedRow'] entry must land first). NOTES (N6, armed-not-fired, route CHIEF/OWNER): S-08 tombstone-by-omission — the upsert has no removal path, so an event Core removes by omitting it is retained at its last-seen state (overstates liveness); TODO(contract) already flags tombstone semantics as chief-owned; V2 huge-version staleness-pin — a valid huge version applies once then pins later feeds 'stale' (availability, not an in-scope gate). GOVERNANCE POSTURE UNCHANGED AND IMMUTABLE: config.py values unchanged; global_gateway_state=BLOCKED, production_flag=OFF, external_send=OFF (asserted after the run), is_external_send_enabled() False. No application code/test/migration/gate/config/state-ledger/release-flag change; no CRM send, no commission math, no Data-Mart trigger, no Core override, no scale/publish, no order-state/pricing; NO egress opened, NO live endpoint built; no enabling value written anywhere.
